subject: radiology
title: Double Bubble Sign, Necrotising Enterocolitis and Paediatric Chest Signs

steps.title: Two bubbles mean duodenal block
steps.tx: **Double bubble sign** pairs a gas filled stomach with a gas filled proximal duodenum and no gas beyond, the plain film signature of duodenal atresia in a newborn with bilious vomiting. The pictured infant film set shows that two bubble pattern beside annular pancreas anatomy, its common partner. Down syndrome accompanies about a third of cases, and polyhydramnios often announced the block before birth.

steps.title: Distal gas changes the diagnosis
steps.tx: **Distal bowel gas** beyond the two bubbles downgrades atresia to duodenal stenosis or web, where a windsock membrane balloons into the lumen, or to malrotation with volvulus, the surgical emergency in the room. Bilious vomiting with any abnormal film in a newborn earns an urgent upper gastrointestinal contrast study and surgical review, because midgut volvulus kills bowel in hours while atresia tolerates a day of stabilisation.

steps.title: Triple bubble and jejunal atresia
steps.tx: **Triple bubble** adds a third gas loop for jejunal atresia, and each lower atresia multiplies dilated loops while microcolon waits unused below. Apple peel atresia wraps the distal bowel around a single marginal artery like peel around a core, a vascular accident pattern with short gut consequences. Antenatal bowel dilatation and echogenic bowel are the ultrasound whispers that prepare the delivery room for these films.

steps.title: Hirschsprung transition zone
steps.tx: **Hirschsprung disease** films show a narrow aganglionic rectosigmoid opening into dilated ganglionic colon above, the transition zone a contrast enema maps with a reversed rectosigmoid ratio. The newborn fails to pass meconium in the first day or two, and the toddler version grows chronic constipation with a palpable loaded colon. Rectal suction biopsy proving absent ganglion cells still makes the diagnosis imaging only suspects.

steps.title: Pneumatosis means necrotising bowel
steps.tx: **Pneumatosis intestinalis** traps gas inside the bowel wall as bubbly or linear lucencies, the plain film hallmark of necrotising enterocolitis in a preterm infant with distension, blood in stool and falling platelets. Portal venous gas branches that intramural gas into the liver, and pneumoperitoneum ends debate about perforation. A football sign of free gas on the supine baby film joins the same emergency set.

Portal venous gas branches into the liver, and pneumoperitoneum ends debate about perforation. All three signs trigger the same emergency pathway.

steps.title: Respiratory distress films in newborns
steps.tx: **Hyaline membrane disease** grounds the premature lung into uniform fine granularity with air bronchograms and low volumes from surfactant deficiency, worst in the first hours and improving after surfactant doses. Transient tachypnoea of the newborn instead shows wet fissures, perihilar streaking and fluid that clears within a day or two after caesarean delivery. Meconium aspiration coarsens the pattern into patchy ropey opacities with hyperinflation in a term baby born through stained liquor.

steps.title: Steeple versus thumbprint airways
steps.tx: **Steeple sign** narrows the subglottic airway into a church steeple on the frontal neck film of viral croup, the barking cough toddler whose lateral film shows a swollen epiglottis staying thin. Bacterial epiglottitis instead prints a thumb: a thick rounded epiglottis with ballooned hypopharynx in a toxic drooling child. That frontal versus lateral pairing is an examiner favourite precisely because swapping the two diseases swaps a home remedy for an airway emergency.

steps.title: Battered baby bone survey
steps.tx: **Skeletal survey** in suspected physical abuse hunts classic metaphyseal corner and bucket handle fractures, posterior rib fractures from squeezing, and fractures of different ages healing side by side. Skull, spine, hands and feet films complete the set because abusive injuries hide where routine trauma films never look. Rickets, osteogenesis imperfecta and normal variants enter the differential honestly, and the survey is reported beside metabolic labs and specialist review, never alone.
